Subject: Updated project delivery date: 14 April

I'm writing to update you on the project timeline. The third-party integration required for this phase needed additional certification cycles from the vendor, and that process has taken longer than originally planned. As a result, the delivery date is moving from the original schedule to 14 April.

Our team has been working closely with the vendor to move the certification along and has already resumed development on the remaining workstreams so that the two-week shift does not compound further. All other project milestones and deliverables remain unchanged, and we will continue to keep you updated as we approach the new date.

Would it work for you to schedule a short call this week so we can walk through the revised timeline and confirm next steps together?
